'''R5-X3''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid|R5-series astromech droid]] operating [[34 ABY|thirty]] [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. It served with the Resistance during their conflict with the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R5-X3 was released as an action figure in a Disney Parks exclusive set in [[2015]]. The package text suggests he is "featured in the new film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']]." It can be seen inside the astromech socket of a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|T-70 X-wing]] opposite the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. The pilot that R5-X3 co-piloted with is unknown.<ref name="TFA" />
